cords.name: p66
cords.notes: Ascher note: "The cord was doubled at the end and secured with a knot. This knot formed a loop of 1.5cm long. Hence, 32.0cm containing the 6L knots, then a loop 1.5cm long, than [sic] a tail of 4.0cm.

cords.name: p89
cords.notes: Ascher note: "The cord was doubled at the end and secured with a knot. This knot formed a loop 7.0cm long. Hence, 12.0cm, then a loop of 7.0cm long with a 1s knot on the loop, then a tail 16.0cm long containing the 7s knots"

cords.name: p96
cords.notes: Ascher note: "The cord was doubled at the end and secured with a knot. This knot formed a loop 4.0cm long starting at the 1s knot. Hence, 9.0cm, then a loop 4.0cm long, then a tail 8.0cm long containing the 7s knots"
